queries.text: If our baby ends up in the special care unit for a couple of weeks after the birth, do we get any extra paid time off on top of normal parental leave?
evidence: each parent may take up to 12 weeks of neonatal leave at full pay
Neonatal leave is taken in addition to birth parent or partner leave.
queries.answer: Yes. If the baby is admitted to neonatal care within 28 days of birth and stays 7 or more continuous days, each parent can take up to 12 weeks of neonatal leave at full pay, in addition to birth parent or partner leave.

queries.text: Will the company chip in for a proper desk and chair now that I'm working from home part of the week?
evidence: Meridian pays a one-off home office allowance to help with furniture such as a desk and chair.
It may be claimed once every 3 years.
queries.answer: Yes. A one-off home office allowance of £400 (UK), €450 (NL), $500 (US) or RM 1,500 (MY), claimed in Atlas with receipts within six months of becoming hybrid; it can be claimed once every 3 years.

queries.text: Can my partner who lives with me use the counselling service too, or is it only for staff?
evidence: Family members living in the same household as the employee are also eligible to use the service.
queries.answer: Yes. Family members living in the same household as the employee can use the Harbour Wellbeing EAP.

queries.text: I came down with flu halfway through my week off. Do I just lose those holiday days?
evidence: If you fall ill while on annual leave, you may treat the affected days as sickness if you report it as in section 3 and provide medical evidence for the whole period.
The annual leave days are then reinstated.
queries.answer: No. If you report the sickness as required and provide medical evidence for the whole period, the affected days are treated as sickness and the annual leave is reinstated.

queries.text: I think my boss is fiddling the numbers and I don't want to raise it with him. Who else can I go to, ideally without giving my name?
evidence: the Meridian Speak Up portal, operated independently by VeritasLine and available 24 hours a day in English, Dutch and Malay, which allows anonymous reporting and two-way anonymous messaging
The Speak Up Officer is Hannah Brightwell, General Counsel.
queries.answer: Use the Speak Up channels: the Meridian Speak Up portal run by VeritasLine (anonymous reporting allowed), speakup@meridian-instruments.example, or the VeritasLine hotline for your country; the Speak Up Officer is General Counsel Hannah Brightwell.

queries.text: There's paste left on the stencil from the last job. Can we use it on the next board?
evidence: Paste left on the stencil at the end of a job may be reused on the next job only if the next job is on the same line
the paste is within its 24-hour open time, and it has not been contaminated

queries.text: A batch of gas detectors just arrived off a cold truck. Do they need to sit for a while before they go on the cal bench?

queries.text: With the new broker, what happens now if one downstream consumer gets stuck? Does ingestion still grind to a halt?
evidence: Broker back-pressure no longer blocks publishers; lag accumulates in the log instead.

queries.text: Can I pull a customer's readings into the staging environment to reproduce a bug they reported?
evidence: Customer data must not be copied from production TesseraCloud to dev or staging environments; synthetic data sets are used instead.
queries.answer: No. Customer telemetry must not be copied from production to dev or staging; use synthetic data sets.

queries.text: Once Finance signs off the month, what actually stops people from posting into the closed period in Atlas?
evidence: The job sets the configuration key atlas.period.lock=true for the closed period in all four entities.
queries.answer: The CLOSE-LOCK job sets atlas.period.lock=true for the closed period in all four entities. The lock is checked with a test posting, which must be rejected.

queries.text: After we've failed TesseraCloud over to Frankfurt, how much notice do customers get before we move it back?
evidence: Customers are notified at least 48 hours in advance through the status page
Failback is not started until TesseraCloud has run stably in euc1 for at least 24 hours
queries.answer: At least 48 hours' notice through the status page (unless done via ECAB, when the Approver agrees the notice), and only after at least 24 hours of stable running in euc1.

queries.text: I set up the line for the changeover and I'm QA-qualified. Can I sign off the first article myself?
evidence: Only the QA inspector can sign the FAI.
The line lead cannot sign the FAI for a line they have set up, even if they hold a QA inspection qualification.
queries.answer: No. Only the QA inspector can sign the FAI, and a line lead cannot sign it for a line they set up, even with a QA qualification.

queries.text: How long does a laptop handed back by a leaver sit on the shelf before we can give it to someone else?
evidence: kept in quarantine for 30 days before reissue
queries.answer: It is wiped with the certified tool and quarantined for 30 days before reissue.

queries.text: When does FORGE_RUNNER_POOL_LOW fire?
evidence: Fewer than 5 Leeds Linux runners online for more than 30 minutes
the FORGE_RUNNER_POOL_LOW alert fires when fewer than 5 Leeds Linux runners are online
queries.answer: When fewer than 5 Leeds Linux runners are online for more than 30 minutes (SEV3 to platform-primary).

queries.text: what's listening on port 2224?
evidence: Forge Git over SSH
queries.answer: Forge Git over SSH on forge.meridian.internal, allowed from corporate networks and VPN.

queries.text: TC_MM2_REPLICATION_LAG paged me. What's the threshold and how serious is it?
evidence: MirrorMaker 2 replication-latency-ms-max above 30,000 ms for 15 minutes
queries.answer: It fires when MirrorMaker 2 replication-latency-ms-max is above 30,000 ms for 15 minutes. It is SEV3, routed to platform-primary in business hours.

queries.text: Where in Vault is the runner token for forge-runner-lds-05 kept?
evidence: Runner tokens are never stored in configuration management; they are held in Vault at secret/forge/runners
queries.answer: At secret/forge/runners/forge-runner-lds-05 (the path pattern is secret/forge/runners/<hostname>).

evidence: SMT-2 at the Penang factory ran 612 TS4E-EN boards (Tessera TS-4e edge node) through the reflow oven using profile RP-HX-07
queries.answer: On 11 March 2025, Penang SMT-2 ran 612 TS4E-EN boards on the HX-MB reflow profile RP-HX-07 instead of RP-TS4E-03. That caused voiding, 540 boards were scrapped and 72 reworked, and it was a SEV2.

queries.answer: It promotes tsdb-dr-01 to primary, switches the euc1 Kafka cluster to active mode, stops MirrorMaker 2 and translates committed offsets for tc-stream-prd. It is idempotent, so re-run it if it times out.

queries.text: What is standard change SC-021?
evidence: Printer queue creation at any site
queries.answer: Printer queue creation at any site, owned by the IT Service Desk.

queries.text: Where does ATLAS_PAYX_FAILED get routed?
evidence: itops-primary and atlas-oncall@meridian-instruments.com; Beacon ATLAS-PAYX ticket
queries.answer: SEV2 to itops-primary and atlas-oncall@meridian-instruments.com, plus an automatic Beacon ATLAS-PAYX ticket (never the old atlas-ops@ list).

queries.text: A return turned up at Rotterdam without MI-F-031 in the box. What do we do with it?
evidence: Units without MI-F-031 go to the quarantine shelf and Support is informed the same day; they are not opened.
queries.answer: Put it on the quarantine shelf unopened and tell Support the same day. MI-F-031 is the decontamination declaration.

queries.text: Which runners pick up jobs tagged large?

Memory-heavy builds
queries.answer: forge-runner-lds-05 and forge-runner-lds-06 (memory-heavy builds).

retained 10 years from the calibration date

queries.text: I'm on the platform rota. If a SEV2 page comes in, how long do I have to ack it before it goes to the secondary, and what's the ack target?
evidence: SEV2 pages within 15 minutes
15 minutes without acknowledgement
Paged responders must acknowledge within the Acknowledge time for the incident's severity in the Incident Severity Definitions
queries.answer: The acknowledge target for SEV2 is 15 minutes, from the severity table. If there is no ack after 15 minutes it escalates to the secondary, and after 30 minutes to the manager.

evidence: verify the bureau SFTP host key fingerprint against the vault entry payx/calderbrook/hostkey before releasing PAYX-MONTHLY (now step 22)

queries.text: The broker check that was added to the failover runbook after the May 2024 ingestion outage: what does it check today, and why is it different from the original?
evidence: The Kafka lead checks the consumer lag of consumer group tc-stream-prd in euw1
Add a broker queue-depth check to the TesseraCloud Regional Failover Runbook before any failover decision
the RabbitMQ queue-depth check added after INC-2024-031 becomes a consumer-lag check
queries.answer: Step 9 now checks Kafka consumer lag for tc-stream-prd in euw1. It began as a RabbitMQ queue-depth check (INC-2024-031 AI-2) and became a consumer-lag check when ADR-019 moved TesseraCloud to Kafka.

queries.text: After the Forge runner token outage, what alert was added, when does it fire, and how quickly does whoever's on call have to acknowledge it?
evidence: Add alert FORGE_RUNNER_TOKEN_EXPIRY_SOON, firing at 10 days remaining and paging Platform on-call as SEV3
Any runner token expires in 10 days or less
4 business hours
queries.answer: FORGE_RUNNER_TOKEN_EXPIRY_SOON fires when any runner token has 10 days or less left and pages Platform on-call as a SEV3. A SEV3 must be acknowledged within 4 business hours.

queries.text: Is it OK to do a Forge runner token rotation wave on the second working day of the month?
evidence: The Atlas month-end close window, from BD-2 to BD+3
BD-1 is the last business day of the month and BD+1 is the first business day of the new month
queries.answer: No. The second business day is BD+2, which falls inside the Atlas month-end close window (BD-2 to BD+3), and that window is a blackout for token rotation. Move the wave to the next available working day.

queries.text: Our backup standard says dailies are only kept 30 days. Does that mean the pre-close Atlas backup from four months ago is already gone?
evidence: is retained for 13 months. This retention overrides the standard 30-day daily retention
Atlas month-end pre-close backup (tag MEC-YYYYMM)

queries.text: We were running a SEV2 on TesseraCloud and now we're going to fail over to Frankfurt. Does the severity change, and how soon do customers need a status page update?

the Incident Commander raises it to SEV1 at the moment the failover decision is taken
SEV1 incidents affecting TesseraCloud customers require a status page update at status.tesseracloud.meridian-instruments.com within 30 minutes.
queries.answer: Yes. A failover is always SEV1, so the IC raises it to SEV1 at the decision. The first status page update is due within 30 minutes, then every 30 minutes.

queries.answer: 17:00 UK time on BD+1. PAYX-MONTHLY is released at 14:00.

queries.text: Mid-failover, the MirrorMaker lag won't come down before we promote Frankfurt. What's acceptable and what do we do?
evidence: is below 30 seconds (30000 ms) for all replicated topics before promotion proceeds
If the lag is above 30 seconds, wait up to 10 minutes and re-check
the Incident Commander may decide to accept the resulting data loss, provided it stays within the 5-minute RPO
queries.answer: The lag (replication-latency-ms-max) must be below 30 seconds. If it isn't, wait up to 10 minutes and re-check. After that the IC may accept the data loss if it stays within the 5-minute RPO, and must record the decision.

queries.text: After the DNS switch to euc1, at what point do we scale tc-ingest further and to how many replicas?
evidence: if tc-ingest CPU stays above 85 percent for 10 minutes, scale further with tcctl scale --region euc1 --component tc-ingest --replicas 24
queries.answer: If tc-ingest CPU stays above 85% for 10 minutes, scale it to 24 replicas.

queries.text: What's the minimum tcctl version I need before running a regional failover?
evidence: Access to the tcctl command line tool at version 2.14 or later, authenticated with a production break-glass role.
queries.answer: tcctl 2.14 or later, authenticated with a production break-glass role.

queries.text: I rotated a runner token and token-info says it expires in about a month. What's wrong?

queries.text: Before draining one of the Penang HIL runners, what do I have to check on the box?
evidence: check for the lock file /var/lib/forge/hil.lock
Never interrupt a job holding the HIL lock
queries.answer: SSH in and check for /var/lib/forge/hil.lock. If it exists, a HIL job holds a rig: never interrupt it. Wait for it to finish or reschedule the host.

queries.text: One runner still fails verify after I've rotated its token twice. Can I carry on with the rest of the wave?
